citation: Marsh D. Cholesterol-induced fluid membrane domains: A compendium of lipid-raft ternary phase diagrams. Biochim Biophys Acta 1788 (2009) 2114-2123, Table A.1.
originalSource: Veatch SL, Gawrisch K, Keller SL. Closed-loop miscibility gap and quantitative tie-lines in ternary membrane mixtures. Biophys J 90 (2006) 4428-4436.
note: Table A.1 lists a two-phase tie-line region with tie-lines at each nominal temperature sampling different overall compositions, not one tie-line per temperature. Two additional T=10C rows in the source table (Lo endpoint y around 0.2, far below the y~0.54 cluster of the other T=10 rows) were not transcribed here: they don't fit the monotonic-boundary assumption this module's classifyPhase() relies on, and the source paper's own discussion (Section 5) flags this low-cholesterol edge of the diagram as unsettled. Treat this dataset as the well-behaved core of Table A.1, not the full table.
